0022600208.text: The Denver Nuggets (5-3) head into their 9th game of the season on the road, with a 3-1 away record, a two-game winning streak, and a spot 9th in the West and 2 games back in the Northwest. The Houston Rockets (7-3) sit 2nd in the Southwest, 0.5 games back, and arrive on a two-game losing streak after going 4-1 at home. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but Denver won the 2025-26 season series 3-1 and beat Houston 129-93 in their last meeting, in Denver on March 11, 2026, and Julian Strawther is out for the Nuggets with a knee sprain while Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain) are out for the Rockets.
